name: Preview three clearly labeled example campaigns
description: Business owner can explore a sample layout without mistakenly viewing it as actual Qloo evidence.
steps: Open CulturePilot and select Explore layout with example ideas
Review the cultural signals and campaign directions
Expand the first campaign Plan & evidence
expected: Shows three actionable campaign cards, explicit ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE · NOT QLOO DATA banner, and a preview disclaimer.

name: Reject missing cultural inspiration on mobile
description: An incomplete input cannot start a Qloo analysis or sample preview.
steps: Select Explore layout with example ideas
expected: Shows a visible validation message requesting business, audience, and cultural inspiration; no campaigns are generated.

name: Generate grounded live campaigns
description: Configured API generates usable campaigns grounded in actual cultural connections.
steps: Keep default Blue Ridge Coffee / Taylor Swift brief and click Generate with live Qloo
Wait for the live analysis and inspect all three campaign cards
Expand the first campaign Plan & evidence, then expand View cultural signals and One simple testing method
expected: Three compact campaign cards initially show hook, Start here and What to measure. Plan & evidence expands to reveal full action, creative interpretation, pilot scope and Qloo evidence. Cultural signals and shared testing instructions expand on demand. Copy brief copies full content despite collapsed sections.

name: Show graceful backend failure for live analysis
description: Upstream errors do not cause a blank or falsely successful screen.

body_json.error: Qloo service is unavailable for this test.

steps: On mobile, click Generate with live Qloo using valid sample form fields
expected: A visible error appears and the app does not claim to have created verified cultural recommendations.

name: Compare the same brief with and without Qloo
description: Comparison shows real model-only output without claiming measured uplift.
steps: Use the default Blue Ridge Coffee / Taylor Swift brief
expected: Shows Same brief. Different evidence., three LLM-only campaigns labeled no Qloo evidence, and three Qloo-grounded campaigns with cultural signals and test plans. States the comparison is not proof of conversion lift. One shared testing method appears once for both sets of campaigns; each card has a short metric rather than repeated experimental instructions.
